desc:
A GAME ABOUT TIDYING UP YOUR MUSIC ALBUMS AND PLACING THEM IN THE CORRECT PLACE.

👍FAVORITE, LIKE, AND JOIN THE GROUP FOR MORE UPDATES👍

💻PC Controls:

MMB to scroll to change which album you wanna hold.
E and LMB to Pick Up/Place
Shift to Sprint.
Q to Drop.
C to crouch.
RMB to Zoom.
T for Upgrades.
F for Abilities.

Your room, filled with a music collection, fell all over the place after a minor incident while listening to music... 😱

⭐Tidy up the room or with your friends (Better with friends!) to put all your albums back into place! 😃
